label: Input paths
subgoals: Read the input delay as the port's arrival after the clock edge
Add the internal logic delay to the capture flop
Subtract the arrival from the period minus setup

label: Output paths
subgoals: Subtract the output delay from the capture edge to get the port's required time
Sum clock-to-Q and the logic delay to the port
Subtract the arrival from the required time

label: Budgeting a feedthrough
subgoals: Subtract the input delay and the output delay from the period
Read the remainder as the feedthrough's delay budget
Split chip-level paths into block budgets that sum to the cycle
